source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging techniques (PDF 63-64).

items: Print statements: code ke alag alag stages (hisson) par print laga kar variables ki values dekhna.
Debugging tools: pdb (Python Debugger) jaise tools se code step by step (ek ek line) chalana, variables inspect karna (andar jhaank kar dekhna) aur program ka flow (chalne ki tarteeb) samajhna.
Error messages: error messages parh kar samajhna ke problem kahan se aa rahi hai.

blocks.text: Misaal: divide function ko zero denominator (neeche wala number, jis se divide karte hain) ke saath call kiya jata hai, jis se ZeroDivisionError aata hai. try-except block ghalti pakar kar error message print karta hai, jis se problem pehchanne aur sambhalne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"def divide(a, b) :" aur "return a / b": divide function a ko b se taqseem (divide) kar ke jawab wapas karta hai.
"try :": jis code mein ghalti aa sakti hai, usay try block mein rakha jata hai.
"result = divide (10 , 0)": 10 ko 0 se divide karna mumkin nahi, is liye yahan ZeroDivisionError aata hai aur result kabhi banta hi nahi.
"except ZeroDivisionError as e:": yeh block isi ghalti ko pakarta hai; e mein Python ka ghalti wala message aa jata hai.
"print("Error occurred:", e)": message print hota hai aur program crash (achanak band) hone ki bajaye aaram se khatam hota hai.
Output: "Error occurred: division by zero"; "division by zero" Python ka apna message hai jo e mein tha.
Khud try karein: divide (10 , 0) ko divide (10 , 2) kar ke Run karein: ab koi ghalti nahi aati, aur screen par kuch nahi aata kyunke result kahin print nahi kiya gaya.

blocks.prompt: Yeh program kya message print karta hai?

blocks.text: Yeh program marks ka average (ausat) nikalta hai aur har qadam par DEBUG wali print line se total aur count dikhata hai, jaise print statements se debugging hoti hai. marks ki list badal kar Run karein aur har qadam ki values dekhein.

marks = [70, 85, 90]
total, count = 0, 0
for mark in marks:
    total = total + mark
    count = count + 1
    print("DEBUG: mark =", mark, " total =", total, " count =", count)
average = total / count
print("Average =", average)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"marks = [70, 85, 90]": teen marks ki list banti hai.
"total, count = 0, 0": total aur count dono ek saath 0 se shuru hote hain.
"for mark in marks:": loop (baar baar chalne wala hissa) list ke har mark par ek baar chalta hai.
"total = total + mark": har chakkar mein us mark ko total mein jor diya jata hai.
"count = count + 1": har chakkar mein ginti ek barh jati hai.
"print("DEBUG: mark =", ...)": har qadam par teeno values dikhata hai; yahi print statements se debugging hai: ghalti ho to pata chal jata hai kis qadam par value ghalat hui. (" total =" khud space se shuru hota hai, is liye output mein values ke beech do spaces nazar aate hain.)
"average = total / count": aakhir mein 245 / 3 se average (ausat) nikalta hai.
Output: teen DEBUG lines aati hain: "DEBUG: mark = 70  total = 70  count = 1", phir mark 85 par total 155 aur count 2, phir mark 90 par total 245 aur count 3; aakhir mein "Average = 81.66666666666667" (245 / 3 ka decimal jawab).
Khud try karein: marks = [50, 60] kar ke Run karein: ab do DEBUG lines aur "Average = 55.0" aayega.

items: Debugging ke tareeqe: print, pdb, error messages.
except ... as e: ghalti ka message e mein.
